messages:
emma-cs: Hi team — AcmePay opened a ticket: payments tool calls started failing after the system prompt rollout. They're getting 400 invalid_schema. Customer says calls that used to work now return amount as a string and are rejected. They attached logs and a sample.

suresh-eng: Can you paste a minimal request + response so we can repro?

emma-cs: here's the curl we used to reproduce:

```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/generate -H \"Authorization: Bearer xxxxx\" -d '{
  \"model\":\"gpt-redwood-3\",
  \"input\":\"Charge $100 to card on file\",
  \"functions\":[{\"name\":\"charge_credit_card\",\"parameters\":{\"type\":\"object\",\"properties\":{\"amount\":{\"type\":\"number\"},\"currency\":{\"type\":\"string\"}},\"required\":[\"amount\",\"currency\"]}}]
}'
```

And the response we saw:

```json
{
  \"error\": \"invalid_schema\",
  \"message\": \"argument 'amount' must be number\",
  \"model_output\": {\"name\": \"charge_credit_card\", \"arguments\": \"{\\\"amount\\\":\\\"100.00\\\",\\\"currency\\\":\\\"usd\\\"}\"}
}
```

suresh-eng: Thanks — model returned amount as a string. Any notes on what changed in the system prompt?

noah-ops: deploy-bot: rolled sys-prompt v2 to prod (2026-02-12T23:07Z) :white_check_mark:

alex-ml: Quick theory: our new system few-shot examples include human-friendly examples showing amounts with $ or as strings. If those examples live in the system message without enforced schema examples, the model may mimic that formatting in its function arguments.

emma-cs: Confirmed. Customer said their internal examples (copied from UI docs) used \"100.00\" as a string. Looks like that propagated into the few-shots we rolled.

suresh-eng: Short-term mitigation ideas: 1) strengthen function JSON schemas (we already pass schema) so runtime rejects bad shapes earlier, 2) runtime-level safe coercion (attempt to coerce numeric strings to numbers when schema expects number), 3) a per-request system_override that forces numeric types.

noah-ops: We can implement an autodetection/coercion layer in the runtime that tries safe conversions (numeric strings -> numbers, \"true\"/\"false\" -> booleans). Can do a hotfix but need eng-runtime review for edgecases (e.g., leading zeros, ID strings that look numeric).

alex-ml: Another mitigation: append an explicit system instruction on affected requests: \"When returning function call arguments, use JSON types exactly as defined in the function schema: numbers MUST be unquoted numbers.\" This often forces the model to change output format immediately.

suresh-eng: Repro plan for eng-runtime:
1) call model with current sys-prompt + functions schema + minimal user input
2) observe model_output.arguments serialized as a string with quoted number
3) run runtime coercion patch and confirm the arguments pass validation and downstream tool receives proper typed values

emma-cs: Customer is asking for ETA — their nightly billing job is blocked.

noah-ops: Tentative ETA: hotfix (coercion) in ~6 hours if we prioritize. Need tests for currency formats and to ensure we don't coerce intentionally string IDs.

alex-ml: Also a docs/CI fix: add a check that few-shot/system examples respect function parameter types before we release system prompt updates.

deploy-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-0823 assigned to eng-runtime, priority P1.

suresh-eng: Assigning to @alex-ml and @noah-ops for immediate triage. @emma-cs please keep the customer updated and offer a manual-billing toggle workaround for tonight.

emma-cs: Will do and will pass the workaround. Thanks team :pray:
